legacy_cells.B: HybridFlow: Quantification of Aleatoric and Epistemic Uncertainty with a Single Hybrid Model
legacy_cells.C: Peter Van Katwyk, Karianne J. Bergen
legacy_cells.I: 082_2025_HybridFlow Quantification of Aleatoric and Epistemic Uncertainty with a Single Hybrid Model.pdf
legacy_cells.FN: HybridFlow combines conditional normalizing-flow aleatoric estimates with probabilistic-predictor epistemic estimates and evaluates NYU Depth v2 and UCI regression tasks. The component evidence concerns predictive uncertainty, not clinical trajectories or WM planning.
legacy_cells.FR: Non-healthcare depth/regression benchmarks support an uncertainty-estimation component, not validated clinical dynamics, trajectory calibration or treatment planning.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M7 Outcome & causal layer; M9 Safety & governance
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Benchmark calibration and uncertainty quality separately from predictive accuracy; a downstream WM needs trajectory-level validation beyond this component evidence.
legacy_cells.FX: Title and abstract (p. 1); Introduction (pp. 1–3); Method (pp. 4–6); Experiments (pp. 7–8); Results and Tables 1–6 (pp. 9–13); Conclusion, limitations, and broader impact (pp. 13–14); Appendix and relevant Tables 7–12 (pp. 19–28). The full extracted text was read through p. 28. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: A:I left unchanged. The paper's evaluated applications are depth estimation, general regression, and ice-sheet emulation; no healthcare task or cohort is reported. Some appendix table rows have extraction-induced line wrapping/column alignment artifacts, but they do not affect the supported screening fields. Evidence QA: 3/3 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (100%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 3 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 0 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.
